title: data for diagram.apply
description: Apply ops to the current revision of the attached diagram: all or nothing, one new revision (rev+1; contentRev+1 when any content op is in it). Owner (UI credential, contract 3.5): any ops; the first owner apply on an unpinned diagram also pins it (pointer.pinned = {by, at, rev}). Coordinator on an unpinned diagram: any ops, except a bulk removal (contract 3.4: the request would bring the node or edge ids removed by coordinator lines since the last owner act above 10 nodes or 20 edges), which is 409 needs_owner_act. Coordinator on a pinned diagram: 409 diagram_pinned unless every op is a pinned-allowed upkeep op (node.text with syncs true, a lang and a title or body, setting only the stale language of a stale node; node.set of only verified or tracks) or the request carries fb evidence and holds no remove op (node.remove, edge.remove, region.remove: 409 needs_owner_act, DO: diagram.propose with a bound ask). An evidence-backed coordinator write never changes the pin. An owner apply that bumps contentRev also writes the pointer message (feedback kind diagram) on the task. Response: { ok, rev, content_rev, sha256, bytes, pinned, stale: [node ids], warnings: [{code, msg}] } where warnings is the full lint of the result (never a refusal). Rev 3: a write that removes more than 10 nodes or 20 edges (and, for decide, the accept of a restore_to proposal) is owner-only: an owner device, or for the coordinator a bound ask answered from an owner device (contract 3.3 clause 9, 3.7.1).
x-pinned: coordinator: upkeep ops only, or fb evidence without remove ops

note.description: Why. For an owner content save it becomes the pointer message text, verbatim.

evidence.description: Rev 2 (M1): only an owner feedback fb-N on the same task, kind note, approve, choice or redirect (never diagram), written by an owner UI actor (contract 3.5), with N greater than pointer.owner_seq (the journal seq of the latest owner act on this diagram; fb ids are fb-<journal seq>, so the order is exact). It backs add, text, set and layout ops only; never a remove op, a bulk removal, a restore, a pin or an archive (409 evidence_too_weak). One record backs one accepted write (409 evidence_used). Kept in the side log with the write; auditable, not provable.
